prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1181; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the left-side panels shows deformation of the rear door and quarter panel, consistent with a side impact at an intersection as described. The crush pattern and paint transfer line up with the reported point of contact. The repair plan calls for replacing the rear door shell, straightening the quarter panel, and refinishing the affected area. The labor hours listed are in line with the extent of the damage. No prior damage to this vehicle is known, and the invoices submitted contain no duplicate line items.
